title: VLM-in-Sandbox: Visual Workspaces for Agentic Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sandboxed computer environments support multi-step reasoning with tools, executable programs, and persistent files, yet their extension from language models to vision-language models (VLMs) introduces a distinct state-management problem. Visual reasoning produces intermediate image-valued evidence---crops, masks, overlays, zoomed regions, and analytic renderings---that must remain addressable without accumulating unboundedly in multimodal context. We introduce VLM-in-Sandbox, a training-free framework for agentic multimodal reasoning in controlled computer environments. Its Visual Workspace registers generated artifacts in an image ledger, maintains a bounded active visual context, and lets the model explicitly promote selected evidence for subsequent inspection. translated_title: 沙盒中的视觉语言模型：面向智能体视觉推理的视觉工作区
translated_abstract: 沙盒化的计算机环境支持借助工具、可执行程序和持久化文件进行多步推理，然而将其从语言模型扩展到视觉语言模型（VLM）时，引入了一个独特的状态管理问题。视觉推理会产生中间的图像型证据——裁剪图、掩码、叠加图、放大区域和分析渲染图——这些证据必须保持可寻址，同时又不能在多模态上下文中无限累积。我们提出了VLM-in-Sandbox，这是一个无需训练的框架，用于在受控计算机环境中进行智能体式多模态推理。其视觉工作区将生成的产物登记到一个图像账本中，维护一个有界的活跃视觉上下文，并允许模型显式地提升所选证据以供后续检查。这将由沙盒工具执行的视觉证据生成与视觉证据管理分离开来。在七个基准测试和四个基础VLM上，VLM-in-Sandbox实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出无需训练的VLM-in-Sandbox框架，通过视觉工作区（图像账本与有界视觉上下文）将视觉证据的生成与管理相分离，从而在七个基准和四个基础VLM上提升智能体视觉推理性能。
en_tdlr: VLM-in-Sandbox is a training-free framework that separates visual evidence generation from evidence management via a Visual Workspace (an image ledger with bounded active visual context), improving agentic visual reasoning across seven benchmarks and four base VLMs.
